description: Evaluate JavaScript in a running extension's background, surface, content script, page or targetId. Needs allowEval:true at start (by hand: --allow-eval) on every route, the debug port included, whose runs carry a user gesture. Safari: pages only; extension_logs reads the background.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

context.description: Default background; surfaces must be open (extension_open).

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

tab.description: chrome.tabs id to break a url tie.

targetId.description: A page's targetId (extension_open, or dom_snapshot listTargets); overrides url.

until.description: Repeat until truthy ({} for defaults); never sleep in a shell.

timeoutMs.description: Whole wait in ms, default 30000, max 50000.

name: extension_eval
